caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular puppet theater booth with a pointed, red-trimmed roof and a yellow front panel adorned with a central red and blue geometric design. Across the yellow area above the stage opening, the words "PUNCH AND JUDY BANK" are written in yellow on a patterned background. Two puppets are present inside the booth: on the left, a figure with a blue outfit, white collar, and red hat; on the right, a figure in a red outfit, holding a wooden stick above their head and wearing a pointed yellow hat. The puppets are behind a stage with a black surface and a shallow metal dish. Blue curtains with red tassels are gathered at the top and sides of the stage opening. The interior sides of the booth are red with a lattice pattern. There is a metal crank or handle protruding from the right side of the booth's exterior. The illustration is centered on a plain off-white background, and the name "Beverly Chichester" is written in the lower right corner.
title: Punch & Judy Toy Bank
